summary: Records values from the first Position input into internal channel storage, optionally gated by a second Active input, and outputs the stored channels.
key_concepts: Record CHOP records values from the first Position input into internal channel storage.
The optional second input acts as Active and gates recording while preserving held values when inactive.
Record Input chooses current frame or current time slice sampling; current time slice is generally preferred for audio.
Record Output can emit full range, current frame, frame-shifted current frame, current time slice, or a sliding segment window.
Auto Range clears existing storage when Active turns on during playback and records until Active turns off.
Record CHOP is stateful; Trail CHOP may be simpler for rolling time-history windows, while gestureCapture is stronger for multi-capture workflows.

common_gotchas: First input is the Position/input signal; optional second input gates recording as Active.
During recording, only the first input values at the current frame are used.
Auto Range clears any existing storage when Active goes on while TouchDesigner is playing, then records until Active goes off.
Mouse In CHOP and Keyboard In CHOP are common Position/Active sources for gesture-style recording.
Record Segment is useful for trails/snakes/time-history effects but it is stateful internal storage.
Trail CHOP may be simpler for a rolling last-window recording; gestureCapture palette component is stronger for multi-capture/smoothing workflows.
